newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Telebras still a buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Telebras still a buy.

text.p: -- Salomon Bros/Patrimonio said in a report they were maintaining their buy rating on Brazil's telecom Telebras.

-- "We reiterate our buy recommendation on Telebras shares given the company's good telephony growth prospects, overall regulatory framework developments (liberalization and privatization) and attractive valuation," it said.
-- It said Telebras 1996 net consolidated earnings of $2.7 billion were in line with market expectations.
-- Telebras preferred shares were off 0.1 percent at 101.50 reais.
